text: Turn a real place into a Transport Fever 3 map with the free RealMap desktop app
ref: Transforme un lieu réel en carte Transport Fever 3 avec l'app gratuite RealMap
context: One-line summary of the RealMap mod on its mod.io / in-game Mod Hub page: the mod builds, in the game's Map Editor, a map of a real-world area prepared by the free RealMap desktop app. Keep it short and catchy, informal register as the game.
